definition: a wide tree-lined walk for people on foot
description: On a wide gravel promenade in a park, lined on both sides by tall autumn plane trees and old lamp posts and leading to an ornate iron gate, a huge flock of sheep walks down the middle of the path towards the viewer, herded by a black-and-white collie and a man with a wooden staff. Joggers and walkers with coffee cups line the edges of the path, golden leaves drift down onto the sheep and the low sun shines through the trees.
